payload.text: kovacs legs (hv, 26 Oct, through molt-vc and vc, narrowing 25 Oct's no-ssh rule; vc's watchouts 17 and 21 hold the rule): while kovacs-sysadm is running, every read and change on kovacs goes through it, read-only included, and only when it is not running is ssh fine; never sudo in a probe. A leg is a heavy booked with molt-vc: a request to kovacs-sysadm (the bundle, the exact commands and their expected output) while it runs, vc re-tallying the answers, and over ssh only when it does not. The method, tools and kovacs's state are in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/RESUME.md, the baseline is tmp/dc-2141/kovacs/vbase-2d73b7f/BASELINE.md (slot 83), and a leg runs only its bundle's tree, with rustup's cargo first and each tool's version printed. dc's /var/tmp tool dirs on kovacs (shellcheck 0.9.0 and Lua 5.4.6) stay for the next leg.
